items.title: Primary School Enrollment Rates, 2015-2022
items.subject: Enrollment rate

facts.text: The line chart shows Enrollment rate, measured in %.
2019 is the highest at 95%.
2020 is the lowest at 88%.
Overall the figure rose from 92% in 2015 to 93% in 2022, a change of 1%.
The sharpest decrease is between 2019 and 2020 (7%).
The series peaks at 2019 before falling back.
Values range from 88% to 95%.

items.title: Modal Share of Commuter Trips in City X, 2024
items.subject: Commute mode share

facts.text: The pie chart shows Commute mode share, measured in %.
Car is the highest at 55%.
Walking is the lowest at 8%.
Car exceeds Walking by 47% — about 6.9 times as much.
Car accounts for 55% of the total.
Car and Public together make up 80% of the total.
Values range from 8% to 55%.
